profile.headline: Software Engineer III
profile.summary: Strong experience in developing the web pages according to Information architecture and usability standards using HTML/ HTML5, CSS/ CSS3, JavaScript, OO JavaScript framework, Ajax, JQuery, SASS, LESS, MVC framework using AngularJS and FLUX architecture using React Redux. Extensive knowledge in OO JavaScript design pattern and JavaScript MVC Patterns. Strong experience in developing professional, elegant enterprise web application. Extensive knowledge in building RWD using Bootstrap. Expert in using developer tools for debugging and fixing defects. Strong experience in building cross browser compatible web applications. Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple task and meet deadline. Self motivated to take independent responsibility as well as ability to contribute proactively. Ability to excel at communicating with customer and other team members.
